text: dsh-local-ocr 是供 DeepSeek Harness Web 使用的本地 OCR 工具插件。它注册 local_ocr_image，让模型提交本机图片路径，并可选择识别语言及 fast 或 accurate 模式。插件调用系统 OCR 后返回文字、可选置信度和耗时，适合从截图、文档和扫描页提取文字。需要 Node.js 20 以上及 macOS 或 Windows 系统 OCR。

dsh-local-ocr adds local OCR to the DeepSeek Harness Web profile. The local_ocr_image tool accepts an image path and optional language and speed settings, then returns recognized text. It helps read screenshots, documents, and scans; requires Node.js 20+ and macOS or Windows OCR.
我想让 DSH 读取本机截图里的文字并整理成文本。
How can I extract words from a scanned page or document on my computer?
dsh-local-ocr 的功能「本机图片文字识别」：模型调用 local_ocr_image 并提供图片绝对路径后，插件将路径交给系统 OCR，返回识别文本和可选置信度。
dsh-local-ocr 的功能「识别模式和语言选择」：调用 local_ocr_image 时可传入偏好语言数组，并选择 fast 或 accurate 模式；识别结果由服务规范化为稳定字段。

dsh-local-ocr README · dsh-local-ocr：[English](README.md) | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

An independent local OCR library and DeepSeek Harness tool plugin for macOS and Windows. It does not modify `deepseek-harness`, own a cache, or decide when OCR should run.

dsh-local-ocr README · dsh-local-ocr：The native adapter uses [`@napi-rs/system-ocr`](https://github.com/Brooooooklyn/system-ocr), which exposes macOS system OCR and Windows Media OCR through one Node.js API. Its native work credits [`win-ocr-rs`](https://github.com/JichouP/win-ocr-rs) and [`mac-system-ocr`](https://github.com/DeJeune/mac-system-ocr).

dsh-local-ocr README · Install：Requirements: Node.js 20 or newer, `pnpm`, and an installed DeepSeek Harness `dsh` command.

Install the plugin into the Web profile directly from GitHub:

```sh
npx -y github:littlewrite/dsh-local-ocr install
```

The installer adds the bundle to the selected Harness profile. Restart `dsh web` after installation. To select another profile:

```sh
npx -y github:littlewrite/dsh-local-ocr install --profile web
```

To remove it:

dsh-local-ocr README · Install：```sh
npx -y github:littlewrite/dsh-local-ocr uninstall --profile web
```

For local development, clone the repository and install its dependencies:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/littlewrite/dsh-local-ocr.git
cd dsh-local-ocr
pnpm install
```

The current native dependency supports macOS and Windows. Linux is not supported by this MVP.

dsh-local-ocr README · DeepSeek Harness plugin：The bundle loads `dsh-plugin/index.js`. It registers one model-facing tool, `local_ocr_image`, and creates the OCR service without loading the native addon. The addon loads only when the model calls the tool.

Start Harness normally from the Harness repository:

```sh
cd /path/to/deepseek-harness
pnpm dsh web
```

dsh-local-ocr README · DeepSeek Harness plugin：When the plugin is loaded from a source checkout, it expects the Harness checkout to be the current working directory. Set `DSH_HARNESS_ROOT` only when it is loaded from another launcher or packaged installation.

Ask the agent to call `local_ocr_image` with an absolute local image path:

```text
Please call the `local_ocr_image` tool instead of `read_image`.
Read all text from this local image:
/absolute/path/to/image.png
```

dsh-local-ocr README · Library API：```js
import { createOcrService } from './src/ocr.js'

const ocr = createOcrService()
const result = await ocr.recognize({

The result contains stable fields only:

```json
{
  "text": "recognized text",
  "confidence": 0.8,
  "engine": "darwin-system-ocr",

An image with no detectable text returns an empty `text` value and `confidence: 0`. Set `emptyWhenNoText: false` to preserve the native no-text error.

dsh-local-ocr README · Development：```sh
pnpm test
```

Tests inject a fake engine, so they do not require a host OCR runtime. Native smoke tests should run on each supported operating system.

dsh-local-ocr README · dsh-local-ocr：[English](README.md) | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

一个独立的本地 OCR library 和 DeepSeek Harness 工具插件，面向 macOS 和 Windows。它不会修改 `deepseek-harness`，不负责缓存，也不决定什么时候应该调用 OCR。

底层适配器使用开源的 [`@napi-rs/system-ocr`](https://github.com/Brooooooklyn/system-ocr)，通过统一的 Node.js API 调用 macOS 系统 OCR 和 Windows Media OCR。其 native 实现参考了 [`win-ocr-rs`](https://github.com/JichouP/win-ocr-rs) 和 [`mac-system-ocr`](https://github.com/DeJeune/mac-system-ocr)。

dsh-local-ocr README · 安装：要求：Node.js 20 或更高版本、`pnpm`，以及已经安装并可执行的 DeepSeek Harness `dsh` 命令。

直接从 GitHub 将插件安装到 Web profile：

```sh
npx -y github:littlewrite/dsh-local-ocr install
```

安装器会把 bundle 加入指定的 Harness profile。安装完成后重启 `dsh web`。指定其他 profile：

```sh
npx -y github:littlewrite/dsh-local-ocr install --profile web
```

卸载：

```sh
npx -y github:littlewrite/dsh-local-ocr uninstall --profile web
```

如果要进行本地开发，可以克隆仓库并安装依赖：

dsh-local-ocr README · 安装：```sh
git clone https://github.com/littlewrite/dsh-local-ocr.git
cd dsh-local-ocr
pnpm install
```

当前 native 依赖支持 macOS 和 Windows。Linux 暂不属于本 MVP 的支持范围。

dsh-local-ocr README · DeepSeek Harness 插件：bundle 会加载 `dsh-plugin/index.js`。它注册一个面向模型的工具 `local_ocr_image`，但不会在 Harness 启动时加载 native OCR addon；只有模型真正调用工具时才会加载。

然后从 Harness 仓库正常启动：

```sh
cd /path/to/deepseek-harness
pnpm dsh web
```

从源码 checkout 加载插件时，默认要求 Harness 仓库是当前工作目录。如果由其他 launcher 或打包后的 Harness 加载，可以设置 `DSH_HARNESS_ROOT` 指向 Harness 安装目录。

让 agent 使用绝对路径调用 OCR：

```text
请调用 local_ocr_image 工具，不要调用 read_image。
读取：
/absolute/path/to/image.png
```

dsh-local-ocr README · Library API：```js
import { createOcrService } from './src/ocr.js'

const ocr = createOcrService()
const result = await ocr.recognize({

返回值只包含稳定字段：

```json
{
  "text": "recognized text",
  "confidence": 0.8,
  "engine": "darwin-system-ocr",

图片中没有可识别文字时，返回空的 `text` 和 `confidence: 0`。如果需要保留 native 的无文字错误，可以设置 `emptyWhenNoText: false`。

dsh-local-ocr README · 开发：```sh
pnpm test
```

测试使用 fake engine 注入，不要求当前机器具备 OCR runtime。native smoke test 需要分别在支持的操作系统上运行。
